assumptions.description: All generated rows are equal-weight draws intended to stand for the selected labweight-weighted analytical distribution. No target demographic summaries are known. Age beta(2.25,2.75) rescaled to20-79, female probability0.53 independent of age, and conditional lognormal BMI are explicit construction assumptions, not national estimates.

Conditional arithmetic BMI mean is26.5+0.6*x-0.18*x^2+0.8*female, x=(age-50)/10, with coefficient of variation0.18. Dependence and right skew are assumed. BMI support projects the supplied valid weight/height rectangle:30/2.10^2 to200/1.20^2; no height/weight joint law is claimed.

Borrow the INTERSALT BMI coefficients as pre-selection conditional BP terms, unchanged across age20-79 and sex. This assumes omissions of urinary sodium/potassium/alcohol, country/era, selection, treatment, weight design and measurement differences do not require a numerical slope correction. It is an unverified transport assumption, not equality of the source and target estimands.

SBP conditional location121+6.5*x+0.7*x^2+(-5+1*x)*female; DBP77+1*x-0.65*x^2+(-3+0.3*x)*female, before BMI and noise. All numbers are assumed; nonlinear age shapes permit age divergence qualitatively compatible with the Beijing description but are not estimated age/sex effects.

Conditional Gaussian SBP residual SD13+0.07*max(age-40,0); DBP SD9.5-0.02*max(age-60,0); conditional residual correlation0.55. All are assumed, without deriving adjusted residual covariance from Beijing raw covariance. Joint rejection and nonlinear regression misspecification can alter the requested residual correlation.

Use rejection sampling, never clipping: BMI redraws conditional on fixed age/sex until within projected dictionary support; BP pairs redraw conditional on fixed age/sex/BMI until SBP60-290, DBP30-200 and SBP>DBP. Bounds represent task dictionary selection and positive pulse pressure is a separate assumed feasibility requirement. This conditional selection model is not a measured missingness, pregnancy or labweight mechanism.

Model released baseline BP directly. Target three automated G-TECH MA100 readings two minutes apart after >=5-minute seated rest, usually left arm, with unverified final averaging; INTERSALT two random-zero readings and Beijing two Omron readings differ. All device, visit, averaging and anthropometry transfer effects are absorbed in assumed locations/scales without an estimated correction. Laboratory timing does not change BP baseline time.

Observed BP is modeled for a mixture retaining diabetes, hypertension and treatment, with no latent untreated counterfactual or treatment exclusion. Pregnancy exclusion and laboratory complete-case selection are represented only by the assumed output distribution; no target selection probabilities are known.

Older Beijing source moments are descriptive anchors only. Generated ages65-79 do not reconstruct Beijing source sampling, disease exclusions or unknown upper age coverage. Mean/SD/raw-correlation differences are not fit objectives or clinical tolerances. Strict comparison is unavailable where full conventions/selection or adjusted source variables cannot be represented. Equal weighting, sample SD denominator n-1 and identity units are diagnostic conventions.

Parameters are fixed construction choices. Within-row variation and three fixed-seed Monte Carlo draws do not quantify source, model, or transport uncertainty. Source coefficients, means, SDs and SEs retain separate roles.

3000 rows, row_id1..3000, a seeded NumPy default_rng, and finite500-round conditional rejection limits are computational choices. Exhaustion raises an error and does not clip or fabricate accepted rows. All scientific settings are in this specification.

n_rows.derivation: Task-defined size/analysis centering and assumed finite implementation limit. Coordinates are mechanical, not empirical statistics.

coordinates.derivation: Task-defined size/analysis centering and assumed finite implementation limit. Coordinates are mechanical, not empirical statistics.

max_rounds.derivation: Task-defined size/analysis centering and assumed finite implementation limit. Coordinates are mechanical, not empirical statistics.

age.derivation: Assumed demographic distribution; no target demographic data used. Age endpoints are task requirements.

female_probability.derivation: Assumed demographic distribution; no target demographic data used. Age endpoints are task requirements.

bmi.derivation: Assumed conditional arithmetic mean/CV. Lognormal log-SD=sqrt(log(1+CV^2)), log-location=log(mean)-log-SD^2/2. Support endpoints derived from supplied eligibility ranges.

sbp_location.derivation: Assumed conditional location coefficients; not inferred from marginal elderly means. Beijing motivates inspecting age divergence but does not estimate this surface.

dbp_location.derivation: Assumed conditional location coefficients; not inferred from marginal elderly means. Beijing motivates inspecting age divergence but does not estimate this surface.

bmi_sbp_per_unit.derivation: Reported source coefficient0.7754 per kg/m^2 used under explicit conditional transport assumption; multiplied by bmi-25. Per5 source algebra is3.877, SE0.1795, not a target certainty interval.

bmi_dbp_per_unit.derivation: Reported source coefficient0.5967 per kg/m^2 used under explicit conditional transport assumption; multiplied by bmi-25. Per5 source algebra is2.9835, SE0.1285, not a target certainty interval.

residual.derivation: Assumed conditional scales and correlation. No raw SD or correlation is relabelled adjusted. Marginal moments will differ through covariate and nonlinear effects.

bp_support.derivation: SBP/DBP numerical intervals from task dictionary; positive pulse pressure assumed. Conditional rejection changes the nominal Gaussian law and its slopes.
